scenario: Cross the mac-ip-table-limit via MAC-IPs advertised over a VPLS-PW (remote hosts' ARP/ND snooped on the PW -> v mac-ips)
expected: EVPN_MAC_IP_TABLE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED fires at 90% with correct service_name+limit; CLEARED at 85%. PW v mac-ips count toward the limit.
anti_pattern: Assuming PW-sourced mac-ips are excluded from the limit -- they are included.

expected: Read fibmgrd trace (FibMgrMacIpTableSysEvents.cpp) or configured syslog.
anti_pattern: Using `show system logging system-events <NAME>` to see occurrences -- it only prints the catalog/schema, not fired events.

scenario: Expecting the limit to block new mac-ip learning
expected: Learning continues past the limit; the event is informational (WARNING).
anti_pattern: Treating mac-ip-table-limit as a hard cap.
